title: About the Author
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR George Saunders is the author of six previous books, including the story collections CivilWarLand in Bad Decline , Pastoralia , and In Persuasion Nation . He has received fellowships from the Lannan Foundation, the American Academy of Arts and Letters, and the Guggenheim Foundation. In 2006 he was awarded a MacArthur Fellowship. He teaches in the Creative Writing Program at Syracuse University.
